8,000 photos, backed up to 'the cloud'. It's not in the sky — it's a windowless building with a huge power bill, and your holiday is in there three times over. Save this for next time someone says 'it's in the cloud'.

Sources:
- Most of a data centre's electricity reaches IT equipment and the rest is mainly cooling and power conversion. (Energy and AI (IEA)) https://www.iea.org/reports/energy-and-ai checked 2026-10-28
- Storing an object usually means writing it more than once, in more than one place. (Amazon S3 FAQs - Durability) https://aws.amazon.com/s3/faqs/ checked 2026-10-28
- Common cloud object storage keeps data redundantly across a minimum of three availability zones by default. (Amazon S3 FAQs - Durability) https://aws.amazon.com/s3/faqs/ checked 2026-10-28
